notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.38
notes.notes: Fixed issues with the party feature, such as being unable to join a party.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.36
Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.35
notes.notes: Fixed Issues      Abyss Removal: Nanika falling into the abyss was still listed as active; now properly removed.    Rebound Effect: Corrected the display logic so rebound visuals appear as intended.    Illegal Session Matchmaking: Prevented matchmaking from failing when invalid sessions are present.    Stat Recording: Buff gains, debuff applications, debuff received, and debuff removals are now logged accurately.    New Features      Auto-Drop: While holding the drop key, Nanika will automatically drop.    Damage Effect: Added visual damage effects for clearer combat feedback.    Player Counts by Mode: Game mode dropdown now shows real-time player counts per game mode.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.34
notes.notes: Bug Fixes  Fixed a bug where skills would not activate during combos.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.33
notes.notes: Added Features  Region Selection Feature: Players can now select their residential region when launching the game for the first time.  Quick Matchmaking: Added a fast matching feature that allows players to immediately join any game mode.Improvements  Ranked Mode Matching Improvement: Reduced waiting time for matches in ranked mode by increasing the acceptable rating difference.Bug Fixes  Fixed Class Skill Description Display Issue: Fixed an issue where class skill descriptions were not displaying correctly.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.32
notes.notes: Game System Improvements          Deck Auto-Correction Feature: The system will now automatically correct decks containing illegal Nanika.      Forced Nanika Drop Function: Added a feature that automatically forces Nanika to be dropped in specific situations.      Round End Victory Logic: Fixed the logic that determines winners at the end of rounds.        Interface and Display Improvements          Live Patch Visualization: Download progress for live patches can now be visually tracked.      Live Patch Retry Function: Added a retry feature for users experiencing download issues.      Level Up Display Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where the “LEVEL UP” text would remain on screen when a match starts during level up.      Lobby UI Minor Fixes: Improved usability and visibility of the lobby interface.      Class and Class Skill Selection Screen Improvements: Enhanced visibility for better user experience.        Bug Fixes          Party Information Sync: Fixed an issue where game mode and team size information wasn’t properly sent to the party when returning from a match.      Spike × Makibishi Interaction: Fixed a problem where touching makibishi while having spikes would cause damage to opponents.      Reflection Effect Malfunction: Fixed an issue where players would still take damage despite having the reflection effect active.      Shield Recording Error: Fixed a problem where shield acquisition amounts weren’t being recorded correctly.      Party Leader Selection: Fixed an issue where the party leader was determined by turn order when returning to the lobby.      Nanika Size Adjustments: Optimized the size of Okra and Potato.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.31
notes.notes: ■ New Features  Automatic Live Patch Application: Latest patches will now be automatically applied without requiring client restart.  Skill Activation Sounds Added: Sound effects will now play when skills are activated.■ Improvements  Nanika Activation Timing Adjustment: Previously, Nanika's ability would activate immediately after being summoned or dropped onto the field. Now, there will be a cooldown period before activation.  Time-Out Victory Condition Change: When time runs out, if both teams have equal HP, the winner will now be determined based on score.■ Bug Fixes  Fixed Issue with Stones Appearing on Field Edges: Fixed an issue where Nanika could be generated outside the playable area when using skills that summon Nanika to random locations on the opponent's field.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.30
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented playlists from playing.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver. 0.29
notes.notes: ■ UI Improvements  Display assigned key under each skill icon  Show class and class‐skill descriptions in the lobby  Refine rank change animations (enhanced shadows, smoother transitions)  Fix match history display order (now newest first)  Expand leaderboard column widths to prevent text clipping  Show tooltips on class and class‐skill icons during gameplay  Resolve issue where pre-match UI sometimes failed to appear■ Features & Adjustments  Revise rank rating gain/loss calculation logic for fairer matches  Introduce disconnection penalty (RR deduction on mid-match leave)  Improve unranked matchmaking by widening acceptable RR range  Correct score offset issues on the post-match scoreboard  Change default skill key bindings from Q/E/C to Q/W/E■ Bug Fixes  Fix forced Discord authentication at each launch  Fix issue where lobby cards remained visible after match start  Fix pre-match freeze where players couldn’t move

notes.title: Emergency Patch Ver.0.27

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes – Ver.0.25
notes.notes:
What’s Changed  Available Regions Reduced: From 12 regions to 6 regions
      Reason: To streamline matchmaking and reduce wait times.Bug Fixes  Leaderboard Display: Fixed an issue where the leaderboard would not appear after returning to the game.
Thank you for playing Nanika Game Online! I appreciate your feedback—keep it coming.
